dids.name: ibs_battery_temp
dids.note: Job STATUS_MESSWERTE_IBS (0x22402B). Field order T,U,I then 22 info bytes = 28 bytes, matches length. Ranges in SGBD fix the scaling.

dids.name: ibs_battery_voltage
dids.note: Idle 14.75 V matches DME target 14.8 V in 0x4016; engine-off 12.30 V matches the 12.2 V seen.

dids.name: ibs_battery_current
dids.meaning: Battery current (IBS). In this data positive = discharge (engine-off ign-on draws ~15 A), ~0 at idle (battery full)
dids.note: Sign convention inferred from samples, not stated in SGBD.

dids.name: alternator_target_voltage
dids.meaning: Board-net voltage target from intelligent alternator control (IGR), DREC_IGRINFO[2]
dids.note: Byte0 = IGR status bits (bit0 coded, bit5 battery regeneration active). Engine-off value meaningless.

dids.name: battery_soc_today
dids.meaning: Battery state of charge, current day (AEPINFO2[17])
dids.note: Previous days in bytes 18..22 (69,66,66,65,64 %). Byte 2 (SOC_FIT) reads 68->73 %. Byte 0 = 106: likely battery capacity Ah (coded); byte1 SOH=0x81 looks invalid.

dids.name: battery_capacity
dids.meaning: Battery capacity known to the energy manager (AEPINFO2[0])
dids.note: 106 Ah is not a stock F10 size (90/105 Ah AGM); check registered battery.

dids.name: fuel_level_damped
dids.meaning: Fuel in tank, damped sum of both senders (displayed value)
dids.note: RES_0xD11F: right 2B, left 2B, sum 2B, damped 2B, phase 1B (1 = OK). Matches DME 0x4050 tank 44.0 l.

dids.name: fuel_sender_phase
dids.meaning: Tank phase: 1 OK, 2 a sender faulty, 3 = 2 and no consumption

dids.name: fuel_tank_content
dids.meaning: Tank content as known to DME (CBS data block, TANKINHALT)
dids.note: Offsets derived by walking the CBS_RESET_DATEN_LESEN result list; value matches KOMBI.

dids.name: lifetime_avg_consumption
dids.note: Matches DME 0x404F: 8398 l / 81380 km = 10.32.

dids.name: fuel_total_used
dids.meaning: Absolute fuel used (CBS oil history, COZ_KVBVERBRABS)

dids.name: odometer
dids.meaning: Odometer (RAM copy; EEPROM copy in bytes 4..7)

dids.name: odometer_dme
dids.meaning: Odometer received from KOMBI over CAN (FZG_KM_KOMBI_CAN)

dids.name: operating_time
dids.meaning: DME operating-time counter (ENGINE_BETRIEBSZEIT); same time base as DPF last-regen time
dids.note: Also counts with ignition on. 12.72e6 s = 3534 h. Same counter as 0x4AB4 (0.1 s).

dids.name: operating_time_fine
dids.meaning: DME operating-time counter in 0.1 s (equals 0x4050 operating_time x10)
dids.note: Not documented in the SGBD; identified by matching 0x4050. Not a health value.

dids.name: outside_temp_raw
dids.meaning: Outside temperature sensor raw (heat-soaked when parked/idling)

dids.name: dpf_soot_mass_model
dids.meaning: Soot mass in DPF, continuous model (MSOT_K)
dids.note: DATENRETTUNG CSF Partikelfilterwerte 0x5FB4 (96 B); field layout from table CSF_WERTE, data offset = POS-4 (POS counts 62 5F B4 + 1). Last-regen odometer and time line up with live counters.

dids.name: dpf_fuel_since_regen
dids.meaning: Fuel used since last successful regeneration (QFL)

dids.name: dpf_regen_count
dids.note: 131 over ~82k km = one per ~625 km, plausible. Next field ANFREG reads 2050 (implausible, not used).

dids.name: dpf_last_regen_distance
dids.meaning: DME distance counter at last successful regeneration (LSUM)
dids.note: 82582 km vs KOMBI 81817 km: DME counter runs ~765 km ahead; use only as a delta against DME distance.

dids.name: dpf_last_regen_time
dids.meaning: DME operating time at last successful regeneration (TIRGN). Hours since regen = (0x4050 operating_time - this)/3600
dids.note: Idle: 12721134-12715424 = 5710 s = 1.6 h of operating time since last regen.

dids.name: dpf_avg_load_at_regen
dids.meaning: Average soot load when regeneration triggered (RSOTMOD)

dids.name: egt_max_before_oxicat
dids.meaning: Peak exhaust temp before oxi-cat (drag pointer)

dids.name: egt_max_before_dpf
dids.meaning: Peak exhaust temp before DPF (drag pointer)

dids.name: egt_max_before_dpf_regen
dids.meaning: Peak exhaust temp before DPF during regeneration

dids.name: dpf_total_regen_time
dids.note: 292862 s = 81 h over 131 regens (~37 min each, on the long side).

dids.name: idle_speed_abs
dids.note: 680 rpm = OBD rpm.

dids.name: fuel_total_dme
dids.meaning: Total fuel used (QFLCSFRES, first 4 bytes; normal fuel in bytes 4..7)
dids.note: SGBD says 14 bytes, ECU returns 8.

dids.name: oil_pressure_sensor
dids.note: Engine-off -971 hPa = minus baro (OBD 0x33 = 97 kPa), so it looks like gauge pressure with sensor unpowered. Idle 9528 hPa (9.5 bar) is too high for a hot N57 at idle; do not show until checked against live 0x4B5E.

dids.name: boost_actuator_duty
dids.note: STELLER table (STEUERN_WERT_LESEN). 0x61xx twin reads near-identical = probably actual/feedback of the same actuator.

dids.name: metering_unit_duty
dids.note: STELLER table (STEUERN_WERT_LESEN). 0x61xx twin reads near-identical = probably actual/feedback of the same actuator.

dids.name: rail_pressure_valve_duty
dids.note: STELLER table (STEUERN_WERT_LESEN). 0x61xx twin reads near-identical = probably actual/feedback of the same actuator.

dids.name: radiator_fan_duty
dids.meaning: Electric radiator fan duty (8..93 % active range; 7 % = off)
dids.note: STELLER table (STEUERN_WERT_LESEN). 0x61xx twin reads near-identical = probably actual/feedback of the same actuator.

dids.name: fuel_prefeed_pump_flow
dids.note: STELLER table (STEUERN_WERT_LESEN). 0x61xx twin reads near-identical = probably actual/feedback of the same actuator.

dids.name: swirl_flap_duty
dids.note: STELLER table (STEUERN_WERT_LESEN). 0x61xx twin reads near-identical = probably actual/feedback of the same actuator.

24F7.text: Kraftstofffilterheizung, Ansteuerung: Unterbrechung (fuel filter heater, control circuit open)
24F7.meaning: DME sees an open circuit on the fuel-filter heater output. Status 0x2E = failed this drive, pending, confirmed, failed since clear; not failing at the moment of reading. Usual causes: heater element or connector at the filter housing, wiring.
24F7.severity_hint: low in India climate (heater only matters below ~0 C, diesel waxing). Fix at next service; not urgent.

93076B.meaning: CAS switched off terminal 30B because the standby energy budget ran out (car woke/stayed awake too long while parked).
93076B.severity_hint: info; watch if it repeats (parasitic drain).

9308A7.meaning: Rear-seat entertainment remote reports a low battery.

B7F67D.meaning: Cluster watchdog reset (stored, status 0x08 = confirmed only, not active).

B7F884.severity_hint: watch (may relate to our file writes).

B7F8AE.text: Ethernet Verbindung Head-Unit zum RSE High: Link Status nicht ok
B7F8AE.meaning: Ethernet link HU to rear entertainment not up.

B7F8E5.meaning: SSH/telnet enabled on NBT (expected after our unlock).

E1C440.text: Reset (MOST block of NBT fault table)

8011CE.meaning: Climate panel on/off-volume knob button reported stuck.

801C15.meaning: Bus did not go to sleep correctly with 30B (links to CAS 93076B).

800608.meaning: Module 0x5F not identified; SGBD not checked.

health_rules.watch: 115-130 C or <60 C after 20 min driving
health_rules.reason: N57 oil runs ~90-110 C; >130 C means cooling/oil problem.

health_rules.act: >112 C or not reaching 75 C after 15 min
health_rules.reason: Map thermostat holds 90-105 C; >112 C is near boil; low = thermostat stuck open.
IGR targets ~14-14.8 V; outside = alternator/regulator fault.
AGM rest voltage maps to SoC; <12.1 V ~ <50 % and start risk.
BMW energy manager starts cutting loads below ~50-60 %.
Big draw with engine off drains battery fast; parked (sleep) should be <0.1 A, not visible here.
Boot-mounted AGM; heat shortens life.
Reserve warning ~8-10 l; running low risks sucking air into the common-rail system.
2/3 = a tank sender faulty.

health_rules.act: >35 g or rising with no regen
health_rules.reason: N57 regen triggers ~20-30 g; well above that = regen not completing (short trips). Thresholds approximate.

health_rules.value: hours/km since last regen (0x4050 time - 0x5FB4 time, or 0x44BF)
health_rules.reason: Typical interval here ~625 km; long gaps mean regens are being aborted.
High idle back-pressure = loaded/ash-blocked DPF. Approximate.
Regen runs ~600-650 C; peaks >800 C risk DPF cracking.
Persistent deviation = pump/metering-unit/injector leak-off issue (DME will log 3xxx faults).

health_rules.value: boost actual vs target (0x4841/0x42C8) under load
health_rules.reason: Under-boost = boost leak/VNT sticking; over-boost = VNT stuck closed.
From OELNIVEAU_TAB. Overfill on a diesel can mean fuel dilution from DPF regens.
Context only (raw sensor heat-soaks when parked).
Warm idle ~680 rpm; raised idle is normal during regen/low battery.
Fan working hard at normal temps hints at A/C or cooling issue.
Active faults matter more than history.

used.why: N57 DDE7.31 F-series UDS. SG_FUNKTIONEN, ABGLEICH, STELLER, CSF_WERTE tables, 0x40xx jobs (IBS, CBS, AEP), DTC text 24F7.
N57O1 DDE7.41 F-series. Matches more of our DIDs (0x5F92 232 B, 0x5F93 110 B, 0x5E24-0x5E2F exist only here), so the car may run this generation; same measurement IDs/scaling.
Older N57 DDE7.3 F01/F10 UDS; fewer matches.
F01-family KOMBI (UDS). All KOMBI DIDs used here.

not_found: No SGBD matched the SVK ids directly (docs pages do not list SWFL/HWEL), so the exact DME SGBD (d73n57e0 vs d70bx7a0) is not confirmed.

Oil temperature, oil level, live rail/boost/DPF diff pressure, EGT, glow plugs, coolant via UDS: their DIDs (0x41xx-0x59xx SG_FUNKTIONEN) were not in the answered scan. Listed under untested_measurement_dids.
Byte layouts for 0x5FD1 (oil condition), 0x5FD2 (oil level calibration), 0x4017/0x4022/0x403B, 0x5F94, 0x404E: not decoded.
CBS service items (oil/brakes/inspection due) not in the scanned KOMBI DIDs.
Gearbox oil temp: EGS not scanned; DME mirror 0x46F0 untested.
